form_idle_capture.relation_resolution: Resolve every IDREF token to the actual target element, capture referenced owner/type/raw text, and prove the target ID occurs exactly once; unresolved or duplicate IDs fail the semantic gate.
semantic_duplication_checks: For form aria-describedby, compare every current referenced text/owner to the intended direct-call paragraph.
For service aria-labelledby, compare every current referenced text/owner to the intended service label.
For city aria-describedby, compare every current referenced text/owner to the intended city help.
If the exact intended element ID is already referenced, v005 addIdRef is a no-op for that relation.
If a different existing referenced element already supplies semantically equivalent intended text/purpose, HOLD v005 to avoid duplicate computed speech.
If a different native relation is stronger or semantically different but valid, HOLD and reconcile ownership rather than append blindly.
